Dear Keepers of Secrets,

We recently came across a remarkable community-created project—the Morimens Boss Compendium. We were deeply moved by the dedication behind it. After speaking with the project coordinator, we are delighted to share it with the entire community and present its contributors with the Community Contribution Honor Award.

This Boss Compendium has been independently compiled and continuously updated by a group of players. It covers Boss information from multiple story chapters and features standardized page templates, all freely available for every Keeper of Secrets to consult.

Project Link:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QYciqHJY3BilDcdvBiIT_dOqXOdqGX-4FBDj5rL6qyA/edit?gid=1785252148#gid=1785252148

Contributors (listed in no particular order):

Mira: Created the Google Sheet that brings all the pages together; worked on entries for multiple story chapters; handled quality control and fixes.
Blaven: Worked on entries for multiple story chapters; helped track the project’s progress; created template pages; handled quality control.
sol: Gathered information for the latest story chapters; worked on several pages; provided feedback on the pages.
Leona: Gathered information for a large number of story chapters.
Grimmu♡: Worked on a limited number of pages; provided feedback and page updates.
ZekieI: Gathered information for a large number of story chapters; helped create the template pages.
Jotaro: Gathered information for several story chapters.
Leonora: Coordinated the project; gathered information; created pages; handled quality control and fixes; contributed to the initial planning.
Within seven days, each contributor to the project will receive Silver Core ×2,500. Once again, thank you all for the tremendous time and effort you have devoted to this project.

亲爱的守密人：

我们在社区中注意到一些玩家自发创作的视频——【Song of Memento - Русский кавер 】，创作者们以俄语重新演绎了 Song of Memento，并为这支歌亲手绘制了大量视觉素材、重制了角色建模，最终制作出一支氛围与沙耶高度契合的 MV。从歌声、画面到建模，每一处细节都凝聚着他们对这位角色的热爱。经与创作者沟通并获授权，我们在此向全体玩家分享这份作品，并向其授予「社区共建·荣誉奖励」。

项目链接：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ba_aSvP_s4I

参与成员:（排名不分先后）

Dear Keepers,

We recently came across a fan-made video created by members of our community—“Song of Memento — Русский кавер.” The creators reinterpreted “Song of Memento” in Russian, hand-drew a wealth of visual assets for the song, and recreated the character models, ultimately producing a music video whose atmosphere perfectly captures Saya. From the vocals and visuals to the modeling, every detail reflects their love for the character.

After communicating with the creators and receiving their permission, we are delighted to share this work with the entire community and present them with the Community Contribution Honorary Award.

Project link:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ba_aSvP_s4I
